page.overview:
What is Unctuous Osbert?

Minister Unctuous Osbert was a British wizard who served as the tenth Minister for Magic of the British Ministry of Magic, in office from 1789 to 1798.

His term in office was somewhat controversial, as he was too much influenced by pure-bloods of wealth and status; accused of having been a puppet in the hands of Septimus Malfoy. Osbert was elected at least twice.

Unctuous was born a wizard into the pure-blood or half-blood Osbert family, likely somewhere in the British Isles or Ireland. It is possible that he attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in his youth.

Unctuous Osbert was elected Minister for Magic of Great Britain sometime into the late eighteenth century.
